prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop web app UI design mockup, landscape 1536x1024, titled Monochrome Listening Stats. This is an actual music app interface, not a poster, photo of a screen or marketing landing page. Composition A: immersive listening constellation. Left app sidebar 170px wide dark charcoal, tiny monochrome logo Monochrome; nav Home, Library, Upload, Listening stats (selected), Settings. Main area 1260px wide, 40px margins. Top utility header "Listening stats" small left, Refresh and Export buttons right. Under it native-looking rounded period segmented control Day Week Month Year Lifetime, Week selected, date navigation right. A large unboxed hero canvas roughly 500px high: central very bold 110px numeric display "1,284" in near-white, label "minutes listened", smaller comparison "+18% this week"; this is the focal point. Place 4-5 colorful square album artworks around this central metric on thin concentric orbital paths, in 3D perspective, varying sizes 85px to 165px, rounded 14px; constellation is sparse enough that all text is clear. One abstract pink/cyan dance release artwork, one yellow laundromat cover, one black-and-white artist portrait. Subtle colorful refracted light behind artworks, colors come only from the artwork, not an arbitrary neon brand. At canvas base three open metric cells, "432 streams", "18 artists", "6 active days", not equal boxed dashboard tiles. Below stage, a wide readable thin flowing cyan-to-pink listening activity line chart with a focused point tooltip; beside it compact "Your rotation" artwork-led tonal ring and artist legend. Reveal beginnings of next fold: "On repeat" top tracks rows (Picture in My Mind / PinkPantheress; CRAZY (feat. PinkPantheress) / LE SSERAFIM) and a 24-hour rhythmic histogram. Existing app player bar stays slim at bottom. Visual system: rich charcoal #0a0a0a background, off-white sans UI type, big bold sans numerals, monochrome shell, generous breathable framing, rounded translucent dark analysis surfaces, finely crafted pill controls. It should feel like ArtCraft's floating media orbit combined with the fluid album-art background and precise controls of a custom high-end music player. Real functional stats, no bento template, no generic SaaS cards, no decorative giant vinyl disc, no random polygons, no illegible tiny text. Fine microanimation implied by paths, focus highlights, artwork tilt. Add small visible note "Design preview · sample data". Equal production-quality finish with other concepts. Flat browser UI, no device mockup.
